helpful: The sal-v4 segment base-rate table with the bracketed reached figures, which gave a direct anchor for the frozen band.
The provisioned petition text and QP file; the petition's own catalogue of prior anti-SLAPP petitions and their fates was the most decision-relevant single input.
The snapshot's document URLs, which let a forward cell fetch the BIO and reply the pipeline had not provisioned.
gaps: A statpack cut conditioned on 'Response Requested' (call for response) would have replaced the least-grounded adjustment in this cell.
The CourtListener MCP server returned HTTP 429 on the first call, so no docket verification of prior denials was possible.

fedcourts query has no caption or text filter, so it cannot surface topical analogues (anti-SLAPP petitions); the --citation filter cost about 355 MB of ranged reads for an empty result, which the note line explains only after the spend.
WebFetch cannot read PDF text; extracting the BIO and reply required a local pypdf pass on the saved bytes.
notes: The BIO and reply postdated the document fetch, so the provisioned inputs carried only the petitioner's side; re-provisioning after a response-requested entry would even out the fan-out's common baseline.
